title: Navitas Systems Announces Dedicated New Building For Starlifter Lithium Material Handling Battery Production
主要内容: Navitas Systems announced the construction of a dedicated new building for Starlifter Lithium Material Handling Battery Production. The 100,000 square foot facility will expand annual capacity to 5,000 Starlifters and enable expansion of lithium cell production line. The new building is located near its existing 48,000 square foot Ann Arbor Michigan R&D and Manufacturing facility. The company reported nearly 200% year-over-year revenue growth in Starlifter sales. Kevin Hykin, President and COO, highlighted the expansion as a strategic move to support both commercial and government defense lithium cell businesses. Mil Ovan, President and CMO, noted a significant shift in the forklift market toward lithium batteries, especially in two and three shift applications. Navitas also secured the UL-ListedTM mark, becoming the only company offering 24, 36, and 48 volt lithium batteries with this accreditation.
